sources.entry: AppGrid - Grid-based keyboard window manager for macOS.

summary.one_liner: AppGrid is a macOS window manager that moves and resizes windows on an invisible grid using keyboard hotkers with Vim-style keys.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes AppGrid as a macOS window manager with Vim-like hotkeys. It moves and resizes windows along an invisible grid laid over the screen. Default modifiers are Mash (cmd + ctrl + opt) combined with Vim keys, and both can be customized. The README includes a Configuration section, but its contents are not shown in the README text provided. It is distributed as a downloadable .zip app. The README also says the project is "beerware" and invites donations.
use_cases: arranging app windows without a mouse
how_to_run: Download the app (.zip) from the link in the README
notable: Grid-based window placement on an invisible screen grid
Default Mash modifier (cmd + ctrl + opt), customizable
caveats: Only macOS is mentioned, so it will not run on other platforms
The README gives no build or install steps beyond downloading the zip
Configuration section is listed but its content is not included in the README text
